words.enDefinition: Documents a new employee receives or completes when joining an organization

examples.en: My manager sent the onboarding paperwork after we agreed on my start date.
examples.zh: 我们确定入职日期后，经理发来了「入职手续文件」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could finish the onboarding paperwork before my first shift.
examples.zh: 我问能否在第一次上班前填完「入职手续文件」。

words.enDefinition: A collection of information and forms given to a new employee

examples.en: The onboarding packet included a map and a list of people to contact.
examples.zh: 「入职资料包」里有一张地图和一份联系人名单。

examples.en: I found the office hours on the first page of my onboarding packet.
examples.zh: 我在「入职资料包」的第一页找到了办公室开放时间。

words.enDefinition: A list of tasks that need attention when someone starts work

examples.en: I used the new hire checklist to keep track of documents I had returned.
examples.zh: 我用「新员工手续清单」记录自己已经交回了哪些文件。

examples.en: The manager added the first week's introductions to my new hire checklist.
examples.zh: 经理把第一周的人员介绍加到了我的「新员工手续清单」中。

words.enDefinition: A form recording basic details about a person employed by an organization

examples.en: I updated the employee information form after moving out of my residence hall.
examples.zh: 我搬出学生宿舍后更新了「员工信息表」。

examples.en: The office sent me a blank employee information form with the welcome email.
examples.zh: 办公室随欢迎邮件发来了一张空白的「员工信息表」。

words.enDefinition: A record containing employment documents and information about an individual worker

examples.en: The coordinator asked whether my training certificate belonged in my personnel file.
examples.zh: 协调员问我的培训证书是否应该放进「员工档案」。

examples.en: I checked that the date on my personnel file matched my contract.
examples.zh: 我核对了「员工档案」里的日期是否和合同一致。

collocations: add documents to a personnel file

words.enDefinition: A recorded set of details about an employee and their work

examples.en: I asked human resources to correct the spelling in my employee record.
examples.zh: 我请人力资源部门改正「员工信息记录」里的姓名拼写。

examples.en: The portal showed my employee record next to the department's contact information.
examples.zh: 人事平台把我的「员工信息记录」显示在部门联系方式旁边。

words.enDefinition: An identifying number assigned to a worker within an organization

examples.en: The administrator asked for my personnel number when I picked up my badge.
examples.zh: 我领取工牌时，行政人员问了我的「员工工号」。

examples.en: My personnel number appeared beneath my name in the staff directory.
examples.zh: 员工名录上，我的「员工工号」显示在姓名下面。

words.enDefinition: A form recording whom an organization should contact in an emergency

examples.en: After moving, I changed the phone number on my emergency contact form.
examples.zh: 搬家后，我改了「紧急联系人表」上的电话号码。

examples.en: Our department asked us to review the emergency contact form during orientation.
examples.zh: 部门在入职介绍会上让我们核对「紧急联系人表」。

collocations: fill out an emergency contact form

words.enDefinition: A guide explaining an organization's workplace procedures and expectations

examples.en: The first section of our staff handbook explains how to report an absence.
examples.zh: 我们的「员工手册」第一节说明了如何报备缺勤。

examples.en: I checked the staff handbook to find the office opening hours.
examples.zh: 我查了「员工手册」，想知道办公室的开放时间。

words.enDefinition: A record that someone has received or read a workplace policy

examples.en: I saved the policy acknowledgment after reading the rules about student records.
examples.zh: 读完关于学生档案的规定后，我保存了「规章收阅确认」。

examples.en: The administrator showed where each policy acknowledgment appeared in the employee portal.
examples.zh: 行政人员指给我们看，每份「规章收阅确认」在员工平台的哪个位置。

words.enDefinition: Rules about permitted use of an organization's devices, networks, or services

examples.en: The acceptable use policy covered the shared computers in our student office.
examples.zh: 「设备与网络使用规定」适用于学生办公室的共用电脑。

examples.en: I asked whether the acceptable use policy also covered the tablet I was issued.
examples.zh: 我问「设备与网络使用规定」是否同样适用于单位发给我的平板电脑。

words.enDefinition: An agreement requiring someone to protect specified information from disclosure

examples.en: The confidentiality agreement described the kinds of student information we would handle.
examples.zh: 「保密协议」说明了我们会接触哪些类型的学生信息。

examples.en: I asked whether the confidentiality agreement covered work that I did at home.
examples.zh: 我问「保密协议」是否也适用于我在家处理的工作。

words.enDefinition: A contract provision about ownership or use of work and inventions

examples.en: The intellectual property clause mentioned materials created during my placement at the museum.
examples.zh: 「知识产权条款」提到了我在博物馆实习期间制作的材料。

examples.en: I asked how the intellectual property clause applied to the designs I created.
examples.zh: 我问「知识产权条款」对我做的设计如何适用。

words.enDefinition: Rules for identifying and handling situations where interests may compete

examples.en: The conflict of interest policy included an example about working for two student clubs.
examples.zh: 「利益冲突政策」举了一个同时为两个学生社团工作的例子。

examples.en: I asked the supervisor which section of the conflict of interest policy covered outside work.
examples.zh: 我请主管指出「利益冲突政策」里哪一节讲外部兼职。

collocations: read the conflict of interest policy
follow a conflict of interest policy
review the conflict of interest policy

words.enDefinition: An agreement setting out the terms of an employee's work

examples.en: I checked the work location listed in my employment agreement before orientation.
examples.zh: 入职介绍会前，我核对了「劳动合同」上的工作地点。

examples.en: My employment agreement named the department where I would start that semester.
examples.zh: 我的「劳动合同」列明了那学期入职的部门。

words.enDefinition: The conditions and obligations set out in an agreement

examples.en: I asked which of the contract terms covered evening shifts at the library.
examples.zh: 我问哪条「合同条款」涉及图书馆的晚班。

examples.en: The administrator went through the contract terms that applied to our placement.
examples.zh: 行政人员逐一说明了适用于我们实习的「合同条款」。

words.enDefinition: A contract provision stating when the employment arrangement begins

examples.en: The start date clause had a different date from the one in the email.
examples.zh: 「入职日期条款」上的日期与邮件上的不同。

examples.en: I checked the start date clause before confirming my availability for the first shift.
examples.zh: 确认第一班能否出勤前，我核对了「入职日期条款」。

words.enDefinition: An initial period used to assess suitability for a new job

examples.en: My contract gave the dates of the probationary period on the second page.
examples.zh: 我的合同第二页注明了「试用期」的起止日期。

examples.en: My supervisor arranged a meeting near the end of my probationary period.
examples.zh: 临近「试用期」结束时，主管安排了一次面谈。

collocations: the end of the probationary period

words.enDefinition: A meeting to discuss someone's work during the initial employment period

examples.en: At the probation review, my supervisor asked which tasks I felt comfortable doing.
examples.zh: 「试用期考评」时，主管问我已经能熟练完成哪些工作。

examples.en: I brought a short list of completed tasks to the probation review.
examples.zh: 我带了一份已完成任务的简短清单去参加「试用期考评」。

words.enDefinition: A formal change to one or more terms of a contract

examples.en: The contract amendment changed the office address while keeping my other details.
examples.zh: 「合同修订」更改了办公室地址，保留了我的其他信息。

examples.en: I kept the contract amendment with the original paperwork for my placement.
examples.zh: 我把「合同修订」和原实习文件放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: A UK document summarizing the principal details of a job

examples.en: The UK employer sent a written statement of employment particulars before my first shift.
examples.zh: 英国雇主在我第一次上班前发来一份「书面雇佣条款说明」。

examples.en: I checked the workplace address in my written statement of employment particulars before orientation.
examples.zh: 入职介绍会前，我核对了「书面雇佣条款说明」里的工作地点地址。

collocations: provide a written statement of employment particulars
read the written statement of employment particulars
issue a written statement of employment particulars

words.enDefinition: A record that someone confirms they received or completed training

examples.en: The portal showed my training acknowledgment after the library completed the orientation.
examples.zh: 图书馆办完入职介绍后，平台显示了我的「培训完成确认」。

examples.en: I asked whether the training acknowledgment was linked to my department's safety session.
examples.zh: 我问「培训完成确认」是否关联院系的安全培训。

words.enDefinition: A visible card used to show someone's identity as an employee

examples.en: I checked the spelling on my staff ID badge before leaving the office.
examples.zh: 离开办公室前，我核对了「员工工牌」上的名字拼写。

examples.en: The receptionist told me where to collect my staff ID badge on Monday.
examples.zh: 接待员告诉我周一去哪里领取「员工工牌」。

collocations: pick up your staff ID badge

words.enDefinition: A document requesting permission to enter a workplace or particular building

examples.en: The building access form asked which rooms I would need during my placement.
examples.zh: 「楼宇门禁申请表」问我实习期间需要进哪些房间。

examples.en: I checked whether my supervisor had received the building access form for the lab.
examples.zh: 我问主管是否收到了实验室的「楼宇门禁申请表」。

words.enDefinition: A form recording workplace equipment assigned to a particular employee

examples.en: The office listed the laptop and charger on my equipment issue form.
examples.zh: 办公室在我的「设备领用登记表」上列出了笔记本电脑和充电器。

examples.en: I checked the serial number against the one on the equipment issue form.
examples.zh: 我把设备序列号和「设备领用登记表」上的号码核对了一下。

collocations: record a laptop on the equipment issue form

words.enDefinition: A record showing which uniform items a worker has received

examples.en: My uniform issue record showed one shirt and an apron from the café.
examples.zh: 我的「制服领用记录」显示，我从咖啡馆领了一件衬衫和一条围裙。

examples.en: The manager updated the uniform issue record when I exchanged the shirt size.
examples.zh: 我换衬衫尺码时，经理更新了「制服领用记录」。

words.enDefinition: A formal statement an employee makes about specified information

examples.en: I read the employee declaration before confirming that my information was correct.
examples.zh: 我先阅读了「员工声明」，再确认自己的信息无误。

examples.en: The office said the employee declaration would be stored with my original forms.
examples.zh: 办公室说，「员工声明」会和我的原始表格一起保存。

words.enDefinition: A document recording an employee's choices about workplace benefits

examples.en: I asked which section of the benefits enrollment form applied to student employees.
examples.zh: 我问「员工福利登记表」的哪一部分适用于学生员工。

examples.en: The office returned my benefits enrollment form because one section was missing.
examples.zh: 由于漏填了一个栏目，办公室退回了我的「员工福利登记表」。

words.enDefinition: A form naming who should receive a specified workplace benefit

examples.en: I asked which plan was listed on the beneficiary designation form in my packet.
examples.zh: 我问资料包里的「受益人指定表」写的是哪个福利计划。

examples.en: The office confirmed it had received the updated beneficiary designation form last Tuesday.
examples.zh: 办公室确认上周二已收到更新后的「受益人指定表」。

words.enDefinition: Confirmation that required health checks for assigned work have been completed satisfactorily

examples.en: My placement coordinator asked whether the office had recorded my occupational health clearance.
examples.zh: 实习协调员问相关办公室是否已记录我「职业健康审核通过」。

examples.en: The hospital confirmed my occupational health clearance before sending instructions for my first day.
examples.zh: 医院确认我「职业健康审核通过」后，才发来实习第一天的安排。

words.enDefinition: A form where workers declare health information relevant to assigned work

examples.en: I asked my coordinator who would receive the workplace health declaration for the placement.
examples.zh: 我问协调员，谁会收到这次实习的「工作健康申报表」。

examples.en: The workplace health declaration was filed separately from the rest of my onboarding forms.
examples.zh: 「工作健康申报表」与其他入职表格分开归档。

words.enDefinition: Reviewing selected records to verify information about a prospective worker

examples.en: Human resources explained which parts of my record the background screening covered.
examples.zh: 人力资源部门说明了「背景筛查」涵盖我档案的哪些部分。

examples.en: The coordinator told me where to ask questions about the background screening.
examples.zh: 协调员告诉我去哪里咨询「背景筛查」的问题。

words.enDefinition: Permission for someone to obtain and review relevant background records

examples.en: The agency asked me to read the background check authorization before confirming my details.
examples.zh: 机构让我先读「背景核查授权」，再确认个人资料。

examples.en: I kept a copy of the background check authorization with my placement documents.
examples.zh: 我把「背景核查授权」的副本与实习文件放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: A company that checks records on behalf of an organization

examples.en: The human resources team told me which screening provider handled the report.
examples.zh: 人力资源团队告诉我是哪家「筛查服务机构」处理了这份报告。

examples.en: I asked the screening provider whether the report used my latest address.
examples.zh: 我问「筛查服务机构」，报告是否用了我的最新地址。

words.enDefinition: Checking whether someone's stated past or current employment details are accurate

examples.en: The former employer provided my start and end dates for employment verification.
examples.zh: 原雇主为「任职经历核实」提供了我的入职和离职日期。

examples.en: The agency asked a question about my summer job during employment verification.
examples.zh: 在「任职经历核实」期间，机构问了我一个暑期工作的问题。

words.enDefinition: Checking study records or qualifications with the institution that issued them

examples.en: The agency asked which university should receive the education verification request.
examples.zh: 机构问「教育经历核实」请求应该发给哪所大学。

examples.en: My old department passed the education verification inquiry to the registrar.
examples.zh: 我原来的院系把「教育经历核实」的问题转给了教务处。

words.enDefinition: An account of someone's employment or performance from a former employer

examples.en: My previous supervisor agreed to provide an employment reference for the placement.
examples.zh: 前任主管同意为我申请实习提供「工作推荐意见」。

examples.en: The office explained what information appeared in its standard employment reference.
examples.zh: 办公室解释了标准的「工作推荐意见」会写哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: A person who can comment on someone's work or professional conduct

examples.en: I asked my placement supervisor to be my professional referee for the library job.
examples.zh: 我请实习主管担任我申请图书馆工作的「工作推荐人」。

examples.en: The coordinator confirmed that my professional referee had received the email.
examples.zh: 协调员确认我的「工作推荐人」已经收到了邮件。

words.enDefinition: A statement from someone describing another person's conduct or trustworthiness

examples.en: My volunteering coordinator offered to write a character reference for the placement.
examples.zh: 我的志愿活动协调员主动提出为这份实习写一封「品行推荐信」。

examples.en: The character reference described how I had worked with younger students.
examples.zh: 「品行推荐信」说了我过去怎样与低年级学生相处。

words.enDefinition: A form asking a referee to provide information about an applicant

examples.en: My former manager asked who had sent the reference questionnaire about me.
examples.zh: 前经理问这份关于我的「推荐信息问卷」是谁发的。

examples.en: The reference questionnaire asked how long we had worked together at the library.
examples.zh: 「推荐信息问卷」问我们在图书馆一起工作了多久。

words.enDefinition: A review of official records for certain criminal history information

examples.en: The placement coordinator explained which office handled the criminal record check.
examples.zh: 实习协调员说明了由哪个办公室办理「犯罪记录核查」。

examples.en: I asked whether the office had received the criminal record check report.
examples.zh: 我问办公室是否已收到「犯罪记录核查」报告。

collocations: a criminal record check for a placement

words.enDefinition: A check of criminal record information by Britain's Disclosure and Barring Service

examples.en: My placement coordinator in England mentioned a DBS check for the school role.
examples.zh: 我在英格兰的实习协调员说，学校这个岗位涉及「英国DBS背景核查」。

examples.en: The office explained which type of DBS check the placement requested.
examples.zh: 办公室解释了这份实习要求哪类「英国DBS背景核查」。

collocations: a DBS check for a placement

words.enDefinition: An official document reporting relevant information about a person's criminal record

examples.en: The coordinator asked which country had issued the police certificate on file.
examples.zh: 协调员问档案里的「警方出具的记录证明」是哪国签发的。

examples.en: The police certificate was kept separately from the rest of my paperwork.
examples.zh: 「警方出具的记录证明」和我的其他文件分开保管。

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚涉童工作审查
words.enDefinition: Australian screening for people who work with children in relevant roles
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚涉童工作审查

examples.en: The Australian placement coordinator asked about my Working with Children Check at orientation.
examples.zh: 入职介绍会上，澳大利亚的实习协调员问起我的「澳大利亚涉童工作审查」。

examples.en: The school showed where to find the Working with Children Check details in its checklist.
examples.zh: 学校指出在清单哪里能找到「澳大利亚涉童工作审查」的相关信息。

collocations: a Working with Children Check for volunteers
check a Working with Children Check number
a valid Working with Children Check

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚雇佣权利说明
words.enDefinition: An Australian document outlining key workplace rights and conditions
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚雇佣权利说明

examples.en: The Australian café included the Fair Work Information Statement with the welcome material.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这家咖啡馆在欢迎资料中附上了「澳大利亚雇佣权利说明」。

examples.en: I read the Fair Work Information Statement while reviewing my orientation documents at home.
examples.zh: 我在家看入职文件时，读了「澳大利亚雇佣权利说明」。

collocations: provide the Fair Work Information Statement
read the Fair Work Information Statement
a copy of the Fair Work Information Statement

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚随需用工说明
words.enDefinition: An Australian document explaining rules and entitlements for casual employees
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚随需用工说明

examples.en: The Australian employer listed the Casual Employment Information Statement separately from the staff handbook.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这家雇主把「澳大利亚随需用工说明」和员工手册分开列出。

examples.en: I found the Casual Employment Information Statement in the folder for casual employees.
examples.zh: 我在临时用工人员的文件夹中找到了「澳大利亚随需用工说明」。

collocations: provide the Casual Employment Information Statement
read the Casual Employment Information Statement
a copy of the Casual Employment Information Statement

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚定期合同须知
words.enDefinition: An Australian document explaining rules and rights for fixed-term contracts
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚定期合同须知

examples.en: The Australian employer included the Fixed Term Contract Information Statement beside my new agreement.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这家雇主在我的新合同旁附上了「澳大利亚定期合同须知」。

examples.en: I printed the Fixed Term Contract Information Statement before discussing the paperwork with my supervisor.
examples.zh: 和主管讨论文件之前，我把「澳大利亚定期合同须知」打印了出来。

collocations: provide the Fixed Term Contract Information Statement
read the Fixed Term Contract Information Statement
a copy of the Fixed Term Contract Information Statement

words.enDefinition: Specific information about employment terms such as hours or work location

examples.en: I asked which of the employment particulars explained changes to my schedule.
examples.zh: 我问哪条「雇佣条件明细」说明了排班变动。

examples.en: The UK supervisor checked the employment particulars before meeting the new starters.
examples.zh: 英国主管见新员工之前核对了「雇佣条件明细」。

words.enDefinition: A document adding terms or information to an existing agreement

examples.en: The contract addendum included a list of sites where I might work.
examples.zh: 「合同补充文件」列出了我可能工作的地点。

examples.en: I checked whether the contract addendum was included in the latest folder.
examples.zh: 我检查了最新的文件夹里有没有「合同补充文件」。

words.enDefinition: An agreement setting terms for temporary work with another team or organization

examples.en: The secondment agreement named the department that would host me for a term.
examples.zh: 「借调协议」写明了我将去哪个部门工作一个学期。

examples.en: I asked whether the secondment agreement showed the date I would return.
examples.zh: 我问「借调协议」上有没有标明我返回原部门的日期。

words.enDefinition: Permission under immigration rules for someone to take paid work

examples.en: I asked which document the office needed to confirm my employment authorization.
examples.zh: 我问办公室需要哪份文件确认我的「就业许可」。

examples.en: The adviser explained the difference between my student status and my employment authorization.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了我的学生身份和「就业许可」之间的区别。

words.enDefinition: An official document granting a person permission to work under specified conditions

examples.en: I checked the name on my work permit before showing it to HR.
examples.zh: 把「工作许可证」给人力资源部门看之前，我核对了上面的姓名。

examples.en: The coordinator asked whether the work permit listed my work location.
examples.zh: 协调员问「工作许可证」上有没有写我的工作地点。

words.enDefinition: An immigration visa category associated with taking up employment

examples.en: I asked the adviser which work visa the employer had mentioned in the email.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，雇主在邮件中提到的是哪种「工作签证」。

examples.en: The information session explained what a work visa was in that country.
examples.zh: 说明会介绍了「工作签证」在那个国家指什么。

words.enDefinition: Formal support an employer or organization provides for a visa case

examples.en: I asked what the employer meant by visa sponsorship in its message.
examples.zh: 我问雇主在消息里所说的「签证担保」是什么意思。

examples.en: The adviser explained why the visa sponsorship question was separate from my qualifications.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么「签证担保」的问题与我的资历分开询问。

words.enDefinition: An employer formally supporting a person's employment-related immigration case

examples.en: I checked the official name of the sponsoring employer against the letter.
examples.zh: 我根据文件核对了「担保雇主」的正式名称。

examples.en: The sponsoring employer sent my placement coordinator a copy of the confirmation.
examples.zh: 「担保雇主」给我的实习协调员发了一份确认文件副本。

words.enDefinition: A worker whose employment-related immigration permission is supported by a sponsor

examples.en: The guidance defined sponsored worker in a section about employer responsibilities.
examples.zh: 指南在雇主责任一节解释了「受雇主担保的员工」。

examples.en: I asked who managed records for a sponsored worker at the organization.
examples.zh: 我问机构里谁管理「受雇主担保的员工」的档案。

words.enDefinition: The date on which a particular permission to work is due to end

examples.en: The adviser pointed out my work authorization expiry date on the copy I brought.

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚紧缺技能签证
words.enDefinition: An Australian employer-sponsored temporary visa for eligible skilled workers
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚紧缺技能签证

examples.en: The Australian employer explained why its guide mentioned the Skills in Demand visa.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚雇主解释了它的指南为什么会提到「澳大利亚紧缺技能签证」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the workshop covered the Skills in Demand visa.
examples.zh: 我问讲座哪一部分介绍了「澳大利亚紧缺技能签证」。

collocations: a Skills in Demand visa application
sponsorship for a Skills in Demand visa

words.enDefinition: An employer's formal nomination of a position or worker for immigration

examples.en: The Australian adviser explained the employer nomination part of the sample application.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这位顾问解释了申请样本里的「雇主提名」部分。

examples.en: I asked which job title appeared in the employer nomination record.
examples.zh: 我问「雇主提名」记录里写的是哪个职位名称。

collocations: an employer nomination for a position

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚过桥签工作权
words.enDefinition: Permission to work while holding an Australian bridging visa
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚过桥签工作权

examples.en: The Australian adviser explained where to find my bridging visa work rights in VEVO.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的顾问解释了怎样在签证查询系统中找到「澳大利亚过桥签工作权」。

examples.en: I asked whether the example listed bridging visa work rights in a separate field.
examples.zh: 我问样本是否用单独一栏列出「澳大利亚过桥签工作权」。

collocations: information about bridging visa work rights

words.enDefinition: A limit on how many hours a person may work

examples.en: Our adviser pointed to the work hours cap in the Australian guidance.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我们看澳大利亚指南里的「工作时数上限」。

examples.en: I asked which dates the guide used when discussing the work hours cap.
examples.zh: 我问指南介绍「工作时数上限」时使用的是哪些日期。

collocations: a work hours cap during term
a work hours cap for visa holders

words.enDefinition: A letter confirming the arrangement and details of a placement

examples.en: The faculty asked for a placement confirmation letter before recording my placement dates.
examples.zh: 院系请我提供「实习确认信」，然后才能记录实习日期。

examples.en: I checked whether my supervisor was named on the placement confirmation letter.
examples.zh: 我核对了「实习确认信」上有没有写主管的名字。

collocations: a copy of the placement confirmation letter

words.enDefinition: An agreement recording responsibilities and terms for a work placement

examples.en: My department checked the hours listed in the placement agreement before orientation.
examples.zh: 入职介绍会前，我的院系核对了「实习安排协议」里的时数。

examples.en: The placement agreement named my supervisor at the host organization.
examples.zh: 「实习安排协议」写明了我在实习接收机构的主管姓名。

words.enDefinition: Documents or records showing that someone has permission to work

examples.en: The office asked which document I would use as proof of work authorization.
examples.zh: 办公室问我打算用哪份文件作为「工作许可证明」。

examples.en: I asked whether the employer still needed my proof of work authorization on file.
examples.zh: 我问雇主是否仍需要留存我的「工作许可证明」。

words.enDefinition: A document explaining how an employer uses employees' personal information

examples.en: I checked who could access my records in the employee privacy notice.
examples.zh: 我在「员工隐私告知书」中核对了谁能查阅我的档案。

examples.en: The organization included a separate employee privacy notice in the induction pack.
examples.zh: 机构在入职资料包里另外附了一份「员工隐私告知书」。

words.enDefinition: A form recording an employee's decision to decline specified workplace benefits

examples.en: I asked which plan the benefits waiver form referred to in my packet.
examples.zh: 我问资料包里的「福利放弃登记表」指的是哪个计划。

examples.en: The administrator confirmed receipt of my benefits waiver form after the orientation session.
examples.zh: 入职介绍会结束后，行政人员确认收到了我的「福利放弃登记表」。

words.enDefinition: A document listing workplace items an employee has handed back

examples.en: I kept a copy of the equipment return form after returning the headset.
examples.zh: 我归还耳机之后，留了一份「设备归还登记表」的副本。

examples.en: The administrator checked that the charger appeared on my equipment return form.
examples.zh: 行政人员核对了我的「设备归还登记表」上是否列有充电器。

words.enDefinition: A document presenting results from a review of an applicant's records

examples.en: I asked who could review the background check report for my library placement.
examples.zh: 我问谁能查看我图书馆实习的「背景核查报告」。

examples.en: The date on my background check report differed from the one in the portal.
examples.zh: 我的「背景核查报告」上的日期与平台显示的日期不同。

collocations: a copy of the background check report

words.enDefinition: A difference between information revealed by screening and the information provided

examples.en: The coordinator asked about a screening discrepancy involving my previous job title.
examples.zh: 协调员问到一处「筛查结果与资料不符」，涉及我以前的职位名称。

examples.en: I sent a letter confirming the correct dates to explain the screening discrepancy.
examples.zh: 我发了一封确认正确日期的信，解释为何「筛查结果与资料不符」。

words.enDefinition: The date an agreement says its term comes to an end

examples.en: My placement letter gave a different contract end date from the project schedule.
examples.zh: 实习通知信上的「合同结束日期」与项目安排不一致。

examples.en: I checked the contract end date before returning the key to the supervisor.
examples.zh: 把钥匙还给主管之前，我核对了「合同结束日期」。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement continuing a contract after its original term ends

examples.en: My manager sent a contract renewal notice after the department reviewed staffing.
examples.zh: 院系核定人员安排后，经理发来一份「合同续签」通知。

examples.en: I asked whether the contract renewal changed the dates on my placement records.
examples.zh: 我问「合同续签」是否改变了实习记录上的日期。

words.enDefinition: An agreement setting terms for the training someone will receive

examples.en: The training agreement listed which supervisor would oversee my workplace learning.
examples.zh: 「培训协议」写明哪位主管负责指导我的在岗学习。

examples.en: I checked the training agreement to see where the training would take place.
examples.zh: 我查看了「培训协议」，想知道培训在哪里进行。

words.enDefinition: A labor agreement negotiated between an employer and workers' representatives

examples.en: The Canadian campus office explained which collective agreement applied to student staff.
examples.zh: 加拿大这所学校的办公室说明了学生员工适用的是哪份「集体劳动协议」。

examples.en: My supervisor pointed to the scheduling section in the collective agreement.
examples.zh: 主管指给我看「集体劳动协议」里关于排班的章节。

words.enDefinition: A category indicating the type of employment a worker has

examples.en: The onboarding form listed my employment classification beside my department name.
examples.zh: 入职表在院系名称旁边列明了我的「雇佣类别」。

examples.en: I asked whether my employment classification would change after the placement.
examples.zh: 我问实习结束后自己的「雇佣类别」是否会变。

words.enDefinition: Specific skills or knowledge a student aims to gain during placement

examples.en: My supervisor and I reviewed the placement learning objectives during our first meeting.
examples.zh: 我和主管在第一次见面时一起核对了「实习学习目标」。

examples.en: The university asked us to attach placement learning objectives to the agreement.
examples.zh: 学校请我们把「实习学习目标」附在协议后面。

words.enDefinition: An identifier used to refer to a particular work permit application

examples.en: The adviser asked which letter showed my work permit application number from Canada.
examples.zh: 顾问问哪封信上写有我申请加拿大许可的「工作许可申请编号」。

examples.en: I matched the work permit application number on the letter to my case details.
examples.zh: 我把信上的「工作许可申请编号」与自己的申请记录核对了一下。

collocations: confirm the work permit application number
enter a work permit application number
look up your work permit application number

words.enDefinition: A site or area where a person is permitted to work

examples.en: The employer asked which authorized work location appeared on my Canadian permit.
examples.zh: 雇主问加拿大许可证上写的「获准工作的地点」是哪里。

examples.en: I checked the authorized work location in the document before meeting my adviser.
examples.zh: 见顾问之前，我核对了文件上的「获准工作的地点」。
